summary: Klondike Solitaire, Spider, Pyramid. Game Collabs: Inscryption & Monument Valley
description:
Previously known as FLICK SOLITAIRE.

Solitaire meets card collection.

A cozy, indie solitaire game, where you collect decks designed by independent artists as you play. 

Open booster packs, and complete the decks you love. Zoom in on any card to see the art and texture in detail and tap on an artist's profile to read more about them.

Collect over 70 decks, with a new one released every month. Discover artists from different countries, cultures, backgrounds and identities working across all mediums: Illustration, comics, printmaking, embroidery, photography, collage, digital art and more.

Collectable decks also include exclusive game collaborations with Inscryption, Monument Valley and Regency Solitaire. 

Designed with extra care to show off all the art's beauty. Hear ASMR sounds while doing satisfying flicks instead of dragging cards. See the cards fly and react to light while leaving a trail of particles. Over 5000 levels, all 100% solvable. No timers, no pressure, loads to solve!

Like a TCG, but it's solitaire! Made to be your new hobby.

Game modes:
• Klondike (Patience): the classic
• Spider: build same-suit columns, played with two decks
• Pyramid: clear the pyramid by pairing cards that add up to thirteen
• Elevens: pair cards that add up to eleven, or form JQK
• Fastest Flicker: join a global card flicking challenge. Can you beat the best time?

Made with love in England by a small indie studio and our artist friends. Previously known as Flick Solitaire.

Got a solitaire variant you'd love to play next? Let us know: feedback@flick.games
